This diagram assumes that the lesson selection activity is already populated as 
described in Figure 38. This flow begins with the user selecting a lesson, 
following the lazy loading pattern this is when the lesson content is downloaded. 
Using the S3Url stored in the LessonModel, the S3 handler can then locate the 
lesson and download the lesson.json file as described in 4.6, from this the S3 
handler knows the order of the lesson’s contents and the various ItemTypes, 
from here it will then construct the List<FeedItemModel>. It is also worth noting 
here that if the ItemType is a video, a videoUrl will be generated here for 
streaming later on, this URL has an expiry date of one hour. 
Within Figure 40 you can clearly see the iteration through the FeedItemList, with 
the large while loop at the start; although, in practice nextItem is called and the 
content manager starts the next activity nullifying the need for a while loop. 
After each question is completed, all stats are returned to the content manager, 
and the question result activity is displayed. 
Finally, once the lesson is complete, the relevant stats, leader board score and 
spaced repletion data will be updated.
